c74object.name: evi.limiterfast~
c74object.digest: A fast no-lookahead limiter with anti-aliased nonlinear clipping
c74object.description:
evi.limiterfast~ is a 'max define' for the evi_limiterfast.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.limiterfast~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
A very basic stereo limiter. Being a no-lookahead limiter, the 'crunch' can kick in quite easily. evi.limiterfast~ features an anti-aliased antiderivative hard clipping function to deal with this. Other than that it features fixed hard attack, a settable soft knee, variable smoothing, release time set in ms. The AGC envelope is available at the far right outlet.

outlet.description: Left limited audio output, might be crunchy.
Right limited audio output, might be crunchy.
The AGC envelope used internally, available here for downstream processing or visualisation.

attribute.name: ingain
attribute.description: Artificially engage the limiter by increasing @ingain. This is the reverse of a 'threshold'. Smoothed internally.

attribute.name: knee
attribute.description: Nearer 0, the knee is hard, nearer 1 the knee is soft.

attribute.name: release
attribute.description: The release time of the envelope detector. The object is tuned to work well with short times.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smoothing factor of the envelope response. 0 = not smooth at all, 1 = aggressively smoothed.
